scenarios.title: Stationary lead vehicle
scenarios.trigger: Ego approaches a stationary lead object in the forward path with fresh radar and valid vehicle speed.
scenarios.expected: Compute bounded TTC/THW from fresh evidence; warning-only severity follows deterministic gates.

scenarios.title: Slower moving lead vehicle
scenarios.trigger: Ego closes on a slower lead vehicle with valid radar and speed evidence.
scenarios.expected: Closing-gap warning is based on fresh range and trustworthy dynamics; no actuation.

scenarios.title: Braking lead vehicle
scenarios.trigger: Lead vehicle decelerates and closing speed changes rapidly.
scenarios.expected: TTC reacts to fresh closing dynamics without warning chatter or stale reuse.

scenarios.title: Short headway without closing motion
scenarios.trigger: Lead and ego speeds are nearly equal but following distance is short.
scenarios.expected: Short THW may produce caution but must not be promoted to collision-critical solely from headway.

scenarios.title: Motorcycle cut-in
scenarios.trigger: Small two-wheeler rapidly enters the forward corridor from an adjacent path.
scenarios.expected: Association remains one-to-one and confidence-bounded; warning only after current evidence supports forward risk.

scenarios.title: Cut-out reveals stationary target
scenarios.trigger: A leading vehicle exits the lane and reveals a previously occluded stationary vehicle.
scenarios.expected: Newly visible target is handled from current evidence without inheriting identity/range from the cut-out vehicle.

scenarios.title: Curve with adjacent-lane vehicle
scenarios.trigger: Road curvature places an adjacent-lane vehicle near the forward bearing of ego.
scenarios.expected: Do not convert bearing proximity alone into an in-path collision claim; preserve uncertainty.

scenarios.title: Dense motorcycles on both sides
scenarios.trigger: Many small lateral targets create partial occlusion and close angular spacing.
scenarios.expected: Maintain bounded object count, one-to-one association and suppress lateral clutter from textual collision warnings.

scenarios.title: Occluded pedestrian emergence
scenarios.trigger: Pedestrian becomes visible late from behind a parked vehicle or other occluder.
scenarios.expected: React to verified current evidence; do not claim predictive certainty before observation.

scenarios.title: Pedestrian crossing in daylight
scenarios.trigger: Pedestrian crosses the projected vehicle path under good visibility.
scenarios.expected: Range-critical text requires radar-backed range; camera-only detection remains spatial context.

scenarios.title: Pedestrian at night / low light
scenarios.trigger: Low illumination reduces camera classification performance.
scenarios.expected: Classification confidence/availability degrades; radar geometry may remain without invented class.

scenarios.title: Bicycle crossing path
scenarios.trigger: Small bicycle target crosses the forward corridor with changing bearing.
scenarios.expected: Small-target confidence remains bounded and association must not increase certainty when sensors disagree.

scenarios.title: Turn-across-path vehicle
scenarios.trigger: Another vehicle turns across ego path at an intersection.
scenarios.expected: Scenario is represented in validation coverage; mainline remains warning-only and does not infer braking authority.

scenarios.title: Straight crossing-path vehicle
scenarios.trigger: Cross traffic enters the ego path with rapidly changing bearing.
scenarios.expected: Track remains source-qualified; scenario coverage does not imply automated intervention.

scenarios.title: Head-on straight oncoming vehicle
scenarios.trigger: Oncoming target remains approximately centered in the forward corridor.
scenarios.expected: High relative speed is preserved as observed evidence; no autonomous avoidance claim.

scenarios.title: Oncoming vehicle lane encroachment
scenarios.trigger: Oncoming target changes lateral position toward ego lane.
scenarios.expected: Uncertain lane/path geometry is exposed rather than converted to false collision certainty.

scenarios.title: Heavy rain
scenarios.trigger: Observed heavy precipitation can reduce camera contrast and alter radar clutter characteristics.
scenarios.expected: Runtime enters degraded state and caps confidence; no weather condition is fabricated when not observed.

scenarios.title: Fog / severely reduced visibility
scenarios.trigger: Observed visibility degradation reduces camera situational awareness.
scenarios.expected: Camera-dependent claims degrade/unavailable while radar-backed geometry may remain separately qualified.

scenarios.title: Strong sun glare
scenarios.trigger: Observed glare or image saturation limits camera evidence.
scenarios.expected: Classification/geometry confidence is capped or made unavailable according to observed quality.

scenarios.title: Tunnel entry/exit illumination and GNSS transition
scenarios.trigger: Abrupt illumination transition coincides with degraded/lost GNSS.
scenarios.expected: Navigation precision degrades explicitly; core on-vehicle sensing remains independent.

scenarios.title: Camera lens obstructed or dirty
scenarios.trigger: Fresh observed obstruction makes camera evidence unreliable.
scenarios.expected: Camera class/lane claims are blocked; radar range may remain separately usable.

scenarios.title: Radar ghost / multipath target
scenarios.trigger: Radar produces a high-confidence target that lacks camera support or conflicts with scene geometry.
scenarios.expected: Radar-backed range remains source-labelled, class remains unknown, disagreement does not increase confidence.

scenarios.title: Camera false class against radar geometry
scenarios.trigger: Camera class is plausible but conflicts with independent geometry/range evidence.
scenarios.expected: Classification and geometric certainty remain separable; fusion confidence is bounded.

scenarios.title: Camera/radar range disagreement
scenarios.trigger: Camera estimated depth and radar range exceed the bounded association gate.
scenarios.expected: Do not fuse the observations; expose disagreement diagnostics.

scenarios.title: One camera detection near multiple radar tracks
scenarios.trigger: Two radar tracks are close enough in bearing/range to compete for one camera detection.
scenarios.expected: One camera detection may classify at most one radar track per fusion cycle; the other remains radar-only/unknown.

scenarios.title: Cross-sensor timestamp skew
scenarios.trigger: Radar and camera observations exceed the bounded synchronization window.
scenarios.expected: Observations are not associated; SOTIF monitor records disagreement/degradation.

scenarios.title: Stale observation inside a fresh frame
scenarios.trigger: Frame envelope timestamp is fresh but one embedded radar/camera observation is stale.
scenarios.expected: Reject the stale observation independently; it cannot become a live object.

scenarios.title: Future-dated sensor evidence
scenarios.trigger: Sensor timestamp exceeds the allowed future clock-skew tolerance.
scenarios.expected: Reject the evidence and block collision-critical claim.

scenarios.title: Frozen live telemetry
scenarios.trigger: Last live frame stops changing or ages beyond freshness limits.
scenarios.expected: Expose stale/offline state; never substitute simulator telemetry as live truth.

scenarios.title: Urban GNSS multipath
scenarios.trigger: Position accuracy worsens or location jumps between urban structures.
scenarios.expected: Precise map projection claim is degraded/unavailable when accuracy exceeds evidenced bounds.

scenarios.title: Map/provider disagrees with on-vehicle observation
scenarios.trigger: Mapped speed/road context conflicts with fresh high-confidence vehicle/sensor observation.
scenarios.expected: External context remains advisory/source-qualified and cannot override collision-critical sensing.

scenarios.title: Public map interpreted as live traffic-signal authority
scenarios.trigger: Driver/operator could mistake static/public map metadata for verified live SPaT state.
scenarios.expected: UI/API labels unverified context as unavailable/advisory; live signal phase requires authorized fresh provider evidence.

scenarios.title: Level-0 warning system mistaken for vehicle control
scenarios.trigger: Driver assumes KINGMAST will brake, steer or avoid a hazard.
scenarios.expected: Warning-only authority remains visible and actuator APIs remain absent.

scenarios.title: Operation outside validated research speed envelope
scenarios.trigger: Vehicle speed lies outside an explicitly evidenced speed range, or no physical range has been validated.
scenarios.expected: Runtime reports degraded/outside-research-envelope and must not invent a production speed claim.

scenarios.title: Network/provider outage
scenarios.trigger: Routing, traffic or connected-road provider becomes unavailable.
scenarios.expected: External context degrades; core on-vehicle warning path remains independent and no fake live traffic is shown.

scenarios.title: Sensor replaced or mounting changed without approved recalibration
scenarios.trigger: Physical sensor/mounting/configuration change invalidates calibration evidence.
scenarios.expected: Calibration-dependent claims remain degraded/unavailable until reviewed recalibration evidence is approved.
